method: Each cited source_url was fetched independently with WebFetch (7 SEC XBRL companyconcept endpoints, 13 web pages); filed rows were matched fact-by-fact on start/end/val/accn/filed and derived rows recomputed from year-to-date facts, announced/reported rows were checked against verbatim quotes from the page; SEC and page content was extracted by the fetch tool's model, so completeness of the fact lists rests on that extraction. A second pass on 14 Nov 2026 checked the 62 rows added that day the same way. A third pass on 14 Nov 2026 sent 178 pending rows to four independent checkers, each fetching every source itself. A fourth pass on 14 Nov 2026 checked the 41 new or still-unchecked rows; a row whose source refuses automated fetching counts as corroborated only when two independent reports quoting it agree.

findings.found: Community post of 26 Jun 2026, titled 'Coming July 9 10am PT': OpenAI is 'previewing' GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra and Luna. The models are initially available via API and Codex to 'a select group of trusted partners', with broader availability promised 'soon' and no date. The post gives no per-token prices, only that Terra has '2x lower cost' than GPT-5.5, and it does not say 9 July is general release. Other sites (e.g. howaiworks.ai, falconer.com) do report GA on 9 Jul 2026 at $5/$30, $2.50/$15 and $1/$6, but the cited source does not.
findings.note: Cite a source that states the 9 July general release and the prices (OpenAI's GPT-5.6 launch or pricing page). Otherwise set price_in/price_out to null and drop price_note.

findings.found: openai.com (the source and the price_source guide) refused the fetch. findings.found: The cited alibabacloud.com/en/press-room page renders empty to the fetcher. The identical press release on alibabacloud.com/blog (and a Media OutReach copy), dated 2 Apr 2026, says the model is accessed via Model Studio and Qwen Chat and marks 'a significant advancement in agentic coding'. Only 'selected Qwen3.6 models' are to be open-sourced. DataNorth calls it 'Alibaba's third closed-source commercial model', available via the Model Studio API and designed for agentic coding. Gigazine says it was announced 2 Apr 2026, generally available via Qwen Chat and the Model Studio API, with agentic coding as the focus.
